provenance: Each observation is explicitly classified as PURE_XNA_DERIVED metadata or RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION; never CNA output
derivation: Foundation 39 member-level dependency edges. Every edge is a call/callvirt/newobj/ldftn/ldvirtftn/jmp operand the IL extractor already collected for the native-reachability fixpoint, kept when it lands on a pinned reference type other than its owner and normalised the same way -- a nested type spelled Parent+Child, a quoted name stripped. The rows below pin the three facts that changed a conclusion: GameComponent's whole body reaches exactly one member of Game, Game::get_Components; DrawableGameComponent's body reaches nine members of IGraphicsDeviceService, which no public signature of that type names, and its Initialize throws InvalidOperationException(MissingGraphicsDeviceService) when the service is absent; and GamerServicesComponent reaches Game::get_Window, which is still one of Game's deferred members.

observations.note: Foundation 39 measured this row as IGraphicsDeviceService with 13 il-only blocked candidates. Foundation 40 built that candidate, so it left the candidate list and the row now names the type the refinement uncovered behind it. This is a RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION row -- a measurement of this projection's own frontier, which a milestone acting on the frontier is expected to move -- not an XNA fact. Foundation 46 moved it again, from 19 candidates to 18, by projecting Dictionary`2 and consuming LaunchParameters -- the only entry that left. Foundation 48 moved it a third time: building GameWindow took the candidate count from 18 to 17, and because GameWindow was GamerServicesComponent's only il-only unmet dependency, that candidate moved from the il-only blocked list -- 12 to 11 -- into partialDependencySatisfied, which is precisely the transition this row exists to observe. Foundation 49 moved it a fourth time, 17 candidates to 15, by projecting the SerializationInfo/StreamingContext pair and consuming both exception types that named it. Foundation 50 moved it a fifth time, 15 candidates to 14, by projecting Audio.RendererDetail, whose deferral was about its producer rather than the type. Foundation 51 moved it a sixth time, 14 candidates to 13, by projecting Media.VisualizationData, whose deferral was about its filler rather than the type. Foundation 52 moved it a seventh time by projecting Media.Video, whose deferral was about its producer rather than the type: 13 candidates to 12, and because Video was Media.VideoPlayer's last unmet signature dependency, that candidate entered the il-only blocked list, 11 to 12. The System.IO.Stream projection moved it an eighth time, 12 candidates to 11, by consuming TitleContainer -- whose only unmapped BCL identity was Stream, and which was the highest-value entry the register named. Nothing else moved: the il-only blocked list and both partial counts are unchanged, because TitleContainer was no other candidate's unmet dependency.
